about.title: About Me
about.shortBio: I'm a passionate web developer with a focus on creating engaging digital experiences.
about.longBio: I'm a passionate full-stack web developer with a strong foundation in Laravel, React.js, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, and modern web technologies. While I may not have years of professional experience yet, I've built several real-world projects that demonstrate my ability to design, develop, and debug full-featured applications from scratch. I specialize in creating clean, responsive, and user-friendly web apps, and I'm constantly learning new tools and best practices. Whether it's crafting efficient APIs with Laravel or building dynamic front-ends with React, I love bringing ideas to life through code.
